sections.text:
1. Worldwide service and support

The PLAYORA team offers game boosting, account buying/selling, approved in-game shop products and staff-managed game information. Support and fulfillment teams operate 24/7. Availability depends on the offering, game, region/server, stock and supported payment route; it does not promise immediate completion. Contact support@playoragames.com or use your private order conversation.

You must be at least 18 and legally able to enter the agreement. Use only accounts and payment methods you are authorized to use. PLAYORA sign-in uses Google or email. Customer, admin and booster identities are separate; staff sign-in requires an authenticator. Never share PLAYORA codes or wallet secrets.

2. What you buy

A fixed package has a stated scope and price. A custom form gives an estimate; staff issue the final offer for you to accept before payment. Your agreement records the game, region/server, result, conditions, price and delivery details. Later catalog edits do not rewrite an accepted order.

Rank, win rate, hero/role restrictions and guaranteed timing are agreed per order. A request alone is not a guarantee. Use the protected access flow when playing on your account; playing together normally does not require your password. Each shop offer states its delivery method: instant top-up using player details, instant code delivery, account sign-in delivery in 24–72 hours, or manual fulfillment within the stated time. Delivery starts after verified payment and complete, valid details or required access. Account sales use private handover with disclosed access and restrictions.

3. Account commission

For new account-sale agreements, buyers pay the account base price plus 5%, and sellers receive the agreed base minus 10%. The fees are calculated independently and rounded to USD cents, half upward. At a $100 base, buyer total is $105 and seller net is $90. The checkout and seller offer must show the breakdown before acceptance. A PLAYORA-funded discount does not reduce the seller's accepted net. These commissions do not apply to boosting or shop purchases and are not added retroactively to accepted orders.

Seller offers distinguish consignment from buy-first. Consignment depends on a verified buyer sale, acknowledged handover, the seven-day initial inspection period and resolution of relevant issues, followed by a 48-hour payout-initiation target with a verified destination. Buy-first targets initiation within 48 hours after verified agreed handover and destination, before resale; a later resale price cannot reduce the accepted seller payout. Exact crypto amounts, offer expiry, fees, withdrawal and dispute conditions are recorded in the offer. PLAYORA pays outgoing payout costs. No seller payment is required in advance to unlock a payout.

4. Payment and protection

Pay only through the supported direct crypto checkout. The initial route is USDT on BNB Smart Chain (BEP-20). Follow the exact invoice amount, network, address and expiry. There is no user wallet, top-up or escrow service. Provider evidence must be verified before fulfillment. Provider checks or network delays do not simulate success; contact support rather than making a duplicate payment.

If PLAYORA fails an agreed deliverable or condition, the affected order receives a 100% purchase refund, even if part of the work was done. An estimate is different from a guaranteed deadline. A repeat, replacement or extension is optional when a refund is due.

Contact order support if there is a problem with your account purchase. PLAYORA reviews the accepted listing, delivery records and relevant evidence, explains its findings and any remedy due under your order terms and applicable law. Refund eligibility and amount depend on that review; there is no blanket refund guarantee for every issue arising after delivery. Failure to deliver an expressly agreed condition remains covered by our agreed-order refund protection. Previously accepted agreements retain their protections.

Verified account damage caused by PLAYORA or its team receives fair monetary compensation separately from an eligible order refund. A lower WR can be reviewed without a purchased WR guarantee. Ordinary match variance is distinguished from verified harm using evidence. There is no automatic compensation cap at the order price or compulsory store credit.

A full refund normally returns the original asset and original units allocated to the order; PLAYORA covers outgoing refund costs. An alternative requires your agreement. Third-party wallet/exchange sending costs and unrelated later purchases are distinct, subject to any additional legal remedy. Previous refunds are accounted for without double payment.

After payment is confirmed, orders cannot be cancelled simply because you change your mind. If payment, delivery or the agreed service has a problem, contact order support. This rule does not reduce a full refund owed for an unfulfilled agreement, failed or incorrect delivery, an account remedy due under the accepted terms, or any cancellation, withdrawal or refund right required by law. Existing accepted orders retain their original terms. General terms acceptance is not a substitute for separately required early-performance consent.

5. Complaints, privacy and changes

We aim to assess claims within 72 hours of necessary evidence, initiate approved refunds within 48 hours of a verified destination, update pending cases at least every 48 hours and finish appeals within seven calendar days. Shorter applicable legal deadlines prevail. In-app reporting/appeal limits do not remove accepted protections; use support if a control is unavailable.

Publishers may prohibit boosting or account transfers. PLAYORA is independent and does not promise immunity from enforcement; that warning does not cancel the protection expressly promised here. Reviews and uploads must be genuine and respect privacy. Negative feedback is not grounds to withhold a refund or payout. Staff articles may become outdated and do not add an order guarantee.

The complete Terms of Service, Privacy and service-specific policies presented with your order explain these commitments in detail. They are versioned. New terms do not silently reduce earlier accepted rights. Nothing waives mandatory rights, imposes compulsory arbitration or designates an undisclosed country as your only route to a remedy.
sections.title: Service terms overview

sections.text:
1. Who handles your information

The PLAYORA team operates PLAYORA's worldwide game services. Contact support@playoragames.com or your private support conversation for questions or privacy requests. Support is available 24/7; a substantive investigation may take longer than an initial reply.

This notice covers customers, account sellers and people using PLAYORA's public site and account portals. Staff and booster accounts are independent identities, with separate profiles, sessions, permissions and security settings, even when the same email is used. Information is accessed across those boundaries only as needed for authorized work, not because the emails match.

2. Information we use

| Information | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| Email, display name, account identifier and accepted agreement versions | Sign-in, account administration, communication and contracts |
| Google identity/verified email when selected, email challenges, sessions, browser binding, authenticator material and security events | Authentication, recovery and protection against misuse |
| Game, region/server, rank, hero/role and WR preferences, quotes, orders, delivery details and progress | Estimate, agree and perform the selected service |
| Account-sale attributes, images, ownership evidence, offers and transfer records | Assess submissions, publish permitted listings and perform buyer/seller agreements |
| Necessary private game access | Perform only the authorized task or secure handover |
| Invoice references, asset/network, amounts, transaction evidence and refund/payout destinations | Verify payment, calculate disclosed fees and administer financial obligations |
| Support chat/email, attachments and case notes | Answer questions, investigate claims and provide remedies |
| Favorites, optional alert choices and public review submissions | Provide requested convenience functions and publish permitted feedback |
| Relevant request, network, device/browser and operational/security records | Run the service, prevent abuse and investigate faults |

Information comes from you, your use of PLAYORA, your chosen sign-in/payment providers, and authorized staff performing the service. A buyer may supply information about a transferred account and a seller's claim; we use it for that transaction, not as permission to expose their private conversations.

PLAYORA uses Google or email sign-in and has no customer password or stored-value wallet. Google sign-in requests identity and email claims, not access to your Gmail messages. Never submit unrelated email passwords, wallet private keys, seed phrases or unnecessary identity documents through ordinary order chat.

3. Purposes and choices

We process necessary account and transaction information to take steps you request and perform your agreements. Security, fraud prevention, service administration and claim defense rely on proportionate legitimate interests where recognized by applicable law. We use a legal-obligation basis only where an actual applicable requirement exists. Optional processing that requires consent has a separate choice; agreeing to general terms is not blanket marketing consent.

Required order information is necessary to provide that service. Optional alerts and reviews are separate, and Google sign-in is optional when email sign-in is available. Withdrawing optional consent does not undo earlier lawful processing or stop necessary transaction/security notices.

Rules calculate estimates and check permissions, availability and payment state. Staff review final custom quotes and contested refund/account decisions. Ask support for an explanation or human review of an incorrect result.

4. Who receives information

Authorized staff and assigned boosters receive only the information needed for their task. Private access is restricted and audited. Seller and buyer private messages are not automatically visible to one another. Permitted public listing details and reviews are different from private proof and credentials.

Infrastructure providers support hosting, DNS, network protection and the operation of self-hosted database, private storage and email services. Google authenticates people who select it. NOWPayments processes crypto transactions and its own verification and compliance checks. Your email provider receives messages addressed to you. Social platforms receive information you choose to send through their contact links. Public blockchains may independently expose addresses, amounts and transaction history.

Google and NOWPayments operate under their own privacy notices, available through their services. Provider reviews may require additional information; PLAYORA cannot promise anonymity or that a third party will never request identity verification.

We do not sell personal information or share it for targeted advertising. Private chat, proof and game access are not advertising permission. Separate permission is required for marketing use of private customer material. Proportionate disclosures may be necessary for an applicable legal obligation or a genuine claim; access must be limited to that purpose.

5. International processing

Customers, authorized personnel and service providers may be in different countries, so information may be processed outside your country. Worldwide service does not imply that all data remains in one place. Applicable transfer requirements and safeguards must be respected. Contact support for the recipients, locations and transfer arrangements relevant to your information; we do not claim an unverified adequacy decision or certification.

6. Storage and retention

We retain information only while it serves an identified transaction, security, claim or applicable legal purpose. The retention schedule distinguishes ordinary messages from essential financial and dispute evidence. Longer retention requires a recorded reason affecting the particular records, not an indefinite hold on everything.

Our approved retention review targets are: ordinary closed support material and routine security/audit records at 365 days; closed dispute evidence at 730 days after closure; and limited commercial/payment evidence at 730 days after settlement. Category-specific automatic cleanup is not yet enabled. These are review targets, not a claim that records are already erased at those ages or a universal legal minimum. We assess verified requests individually and explain specific accounting, tax or claim requirements and necessary holds.

Eligible profile information should be removed or anonymized within 30 days of a verified closure request, subject to specific lawful holds and any shorter legal deadline. Necessary credentials must be removed as soon as authorized access is no longer needed, with an approved review target of 30 days after completed handover/fulfillment absent a specific justified hold. Other temporary data follows its actual technical expiry and cleanup process. Public review attribution is assessed separately from retained financial evidence.

Automatic customer deletion is not enabled. You can still submit a rights request through support. A pending self-service feature does not remove your rights. We distinguish expired access, restricted retained evidence, anonymization and actual file deletion; one is not a promise that every copy has disappeared.

The deployment does not currently have a qualified off-host backup/recovery system. Before one is introduced, copy retention, expiry, restricted restoration and reapplication of deletion decisions must be documented. PLAYORA cannot erase independently maintained public blockchain records.

7. Cookies and security

PLAYORA uses first-party sign-in and browser-binding cookies and limited session storage for safe return navigation and non-secret form selections. The Cookies notice describes their purposes and lifetimes. The site follows your device's reduced-motion setting; there is no active site preference that needs a stored motion choice.

The reviewed application has no identified advertising or behavioral-analytics integration. If optional tracking is introduced, we explain it and obtain any required choice before activation. Selecting a third-party sign-in, payment or social link can involve that provider's own storage.

We use encrypted transport, role-based permissions, required staff second factors and protected game-access storage. These safeguards reduce risk; they do not guarantee that information cannot be lost or misused. Report suspected unauthorized access promptly without putting secrets in the report.

8. Your rights

You may request access, correction, deletion, restriction or portability and object to processing where applicable law provides those rights. You can object to processing based on legitimate interests and withdraw optional consent. We may need proportionate confirmation of account control, using secure channels, rather than unnecessary identity documents in chat.

We aim to respond within one calendar month and respect any shorter applicable deadline. If a permitted extension is necessary, we explain its reason and new deadline. We identify any records that cannot yet be erased and why, rather than describing partial deletion as total erasure. Exports contain authorized records; store them privately.

You may complain to a competent data-protection authority under the law that applies to you. Our complaint process does not remove that right. PLAYORA is intended for people aged 18 or older who can enter a binding agreement; contact us about suspected underage use. This is not a claim that document-based age verification is already implemented.

9. Changes

The effective version and date are recorded with this publication. Material changes receive the notice or choice required by applicable law. Old terms acceptance is not permission for unlimited new uses of information.
sections.title: Privacy notice

sections.text:
1. Our full refund promise

If PLAYORA fails an agreed deliverable or condition of your accepted order, you are entitled to 100% of the affected order's purchase payment back. This includes an agreed rank, win rate, hero or role restriction, product, quantity, required access or guaranteed deadline. An explicitly labelled estimate is not a guaranteed deadline. Partial work does not reduce a full refund owed under this promise.

Contact order support if there is a problem with your account purchase. PLAYORA reviews the accepted listing, delivery records and relevant evidence, explains its findings and any remedy due under your order terms and applicable law. Refund eligibility and amount depend on that review; there is no blanket refund guarantee for every issue arising after delivery. Failure to deliver an expressly agreed condition remains covered by our agreed-order refund protection. Previously accepted agreements retain their protections.

A replacement, repair, repeat service or extension may be offered with your consent. You do not have to accept it instead of an eligible monetary refund. We do not issue compulsory store credit or a PLAYORA wallet balance.

2. What the refund includes

The refundable purchase amount is the payment actually allocated to the affected order, including charges collected by PLAYORA. For an account with a $100 base price and $5 buyer commission, a protected full refund covers the complete $105 purchase payment. PLAYORA does not retain that $5 fee, deduct its processing costs or charge an administration fee.

By default we return the original cryptocurrency and original number of units allocated to the order. PLAYORA covers the outgoing refund fee so it does not reduce that amount. A different supported asset, network or conversion basis requires your express agreement to the exact amount first. A display value in USD is not permission to recalculate a refund at a later exchange rate.

Previous partial refunds count toward the same order total; we do not pay twice for the same purchase amount. A PLAYORA-funded coupon reduces the amount you actually paid and therefore the purchase-refund amount. Duplicate or excess transfers are accounted for separately, not forfeited or converted into credit. Your wallet or exchange's separately charged sending costs, unrelated later game purchases and market-price changes are not included in the order purchase amount, without restricting any further remedy required by law.

3. Cancellation and changes of mind

After payment is confirmed, orders cannot be cancelled simply because you change your mind. If payment, delivery or the agreed service has a problem, contact order support. This rule does not reduce a full refund owed for an unfulfilled agreement, failed or incorrect delivery, an account remedy due under the accepted terms, or any cancellation, withdrawal or refund right required by law. Existing accepted orders retain their original terms.

If we cannot fulfill the agreed order, we explain the issue and offer a full refund or an alternative you choose. We do not silently change the rank, product, deadline or fee. If necessary access or attendance is missing, we contact you to agree the next step; inactivity does not automatically turn undelivered work into completed work or create a no-show penalty.

Applicable statutory withdrawal and digital-service rights remain available. General terms acceptance does not record any separately required request for immediate performance or acknowledgement of the loss of a withdrawal right. An irreversible blockchain payment does not eliminate a legal refund obligation.

4. Damage caused by our team

If PLAYORA, its staff or an assigned booster damages your account while providing the service, we provide fair monetary compensation for verified harm, separately from any full order refund owed. Relevant harm can include rank or win-rate damage, unauthorized asset spending, access loss or a restriction caused by our actions.

We compare the starting account state, agreed conditions, relevant match history and our team's actions. A lower win rate can be reviewed even if no separate WR guarantee was bought. A single loss or ordinary fluctuation is not automatically compensable harm; neither reaching the final rank nor the absence of a global WR promise automatically defeats a supported claim.

We assess reasonable evidenced recovery or replacement costs and lasting loss. We explain the proposed monetary amount; there is no fixed payment per lost game and no automatic cap at the order price. Restoration at our expense requires your consent and is not always technically possible. We do not force more gameplay or store credit instead of compensation. An undisputed refund is not held until a separate compensation amount is agreed, and we avoid paying twice for the same loss.

We confirm compensation amount, supported asset/network and destination before sending. PLAYORA covers the outgoing fee. Compensation and purchase refunds are recorded separately.

5. Reporting and investigation

Use the order's Help conversation or email support@playoragames.com with the order reference, what happened, when it happened and the remedy you seek. Send relevant screenshots or publisher notices with unrelated private details removed. Do not send passwords, sign-in codes or wallet secrets. We retrieve records that only our team can access instead of requiring you to supply them.

We aim to provide a substantive assessment within 72 hours of receiving the necessary evidence and to initiate an approved refund within 48 hours of verifying a usable refund destination. These are service targets; any shorter applicable legal deadline prevails. A provider review or complex investigation receives an explanation and updates at least every 48 hours. We distinguish approval, submission and confirmed transfer.

For completed boosting and shop orders, the published payment policy provides a 365-day in-app reporting window, 30 days per in-app appeal and up to three appeals. Account listings use their accepted inspection/reporting window. These interface periods do not extinguish the protection in your agreement or applicable legal rights. If a button is unavailable, support can still review the claim.

Confirm the refund destination through authenticated support. An exchange's sending address is not necessarily a usable return address. We do not send to a new destination solely because a stranger requested it. If a safe handback of delivered assets is appropriate, support coordinates it; you are not required to recover an inaccessible account yourself.

6. Decisions and appeals

We provide reasons and relevant evidence, distinguish a genuinely buyer-caused problem from our or a seller's failure, and offer a second review by another authorized reviewer where available. Request this in the case or by email. We aim to finish an appeal within seven calendar days and explain any delay.

A protected buyer refund is independent of recovery from a seller. Bad reviews, polite complaints and use of lawful dispute channels are not grounds to remove your protection. Deliberately fraudulent evidence is not covered. Mandatory consumer rights and access to an independent authority or court remain unaffected.
sections.title: Refunds and account damage

sections.text:
1. Account prices and commission

The account base price is the price before PLAYORA's account-sale commission. The buyer pays a commission of 5% of the base price in addition to that price. The seller pays a commission of 10% of the agreed base price, deducted from the seller's proceeds. These percentages apply to account sales only, not boosting or shop orders.

For a $100 base price, the buyer pays $105, the seller receives $90, and PLAYORA's combined commission is $15 before its costs. The seller does not pay a separate advance fee to submit an account, receive an offer, or unlock a payout.

Each commission is calculated independently on the base price and rounded to the nearest USD cent, with an exact half cent rounded upward. The buyer total is the base plus the rounded buyer fee; seller net is the base minus the rounded seller fee. We never calculate the seller fee on the buyer's fee-inclusive total. The exact breakdown is shown before acceptance and payment. Required taxes, if applicable, must be accounted for and disclosed within the confirmed amounts; we do not add an undisclosed tax or administrative charge later.

A seller-approved change to the base price requires a replacement agreement before it affects the seller's proceeds. A discount funded entirely by PLAYORA reduces the buyer's payable amount without reducing the seller's accepted net proceeds. A protected refund returns the amount actually paid, including the buyer commission, not an undiscounted price the buyer never paid.

These fees apply only to new agreements accepted after this policy takes effect. Existing accepted agreements keep their agreed charges.

2. Submitting an account

Submit the actual game, region/server, rank, assets, skin types/counts, linked access, restrictions and history. Images must be accurate and must not expose secrets or unrelated private details. Staff may request ownership evidence and select an authorized public cover.

You must control the account and have authority to transfer it. Do not submit stolen, borrowed, disputed, concurrently sold or fraudulent accounts. Disclose bans, warnings, recovery claims, debts, chargebacks, cooldowns and untransferable access. Submission approval is not a sale or payout agreement.

A separate offer specifies the arrangement, base price, 10% fee, exact net crypto amount/network, transfer requirements, payout timing and expiry. You may decline. Unaccepted offers expire after seven calendar days unless a shorter expiry is shown. Accepted offers are not silently repriced.

3. Selling through PLAYORA after resale

For consignment, we arrange resale after verifying account control. Seller payment depends on a buyer paying and receiving the account. There is no guaranteed sale date or payout merely because an unsold listing has aged.

The standard initial inspection period is seven calendar days after the buyer acknowledges delivery. The seller payout becomes eligible once that period ends, verified buyer funds are allocated, the order is completed, and relevant open delivery, refund or dispute issues are resolved. An acknowledgement alone does not prove that every protection claim has ended.

Once eligible, with a verified payout destination, PLAYORA aims to initiate payment within 48 hours, including weekends. We do not impose an additional routine waiting period after the inspection period. Provider confirmation can take longer; we supply verified transfer evidence rather than treating a submitted transfer as received.

If acknowledgement is missing, we contact the buyer, check handover and explain the delay; we do not fabricate it. A dispute hold identifies the transaction and reason, receives updates at least every 48 hours and review at least every seven days. It is not indefinite confiscation.

The seven-day inspection period controls the ordinary consignment payout timetable. It is not an expiry of the buyer's account protection. A later protected buyer claim is handled separately and is not automatically charged to an innocent seller.

4. Selling to PLAYORA before resale

For buy-first, PLAYORA purchases before resale. The agreed base purchase price minus the 10% seller commission gives your net purchase payment.

After you accept and we verify the required account control, with a verified payout destination, we aim to initiate that net payment within 48 hours. The account is not published for resale until your purchase payout is confirmed. An eventual resale, a later buyer's inspection period or PLAYORA's resale profit is not a condition for paying this purchase obligation.

If PLAYORA later changes its resale base price, the next buyer's 5% fee is calculated on that later price. Your already-agreed purchase price does not change. The combined 15% illustration above applies when the buyer and seller use the same base price; a buy-first transaction with a different later resale price has a different commercial margin.

5. Crypto amount and destination

The initial payout route is USDT on BNB Smart Chain, BEP-20; other USDT networks are not interchangeable. Your offer shows net units, USD base/fees, conversion rate/source and timestamp before acceptance. USDT is not assumed always to equal one USD. The accepted crypto amount is fixed.

PLAYORA pays the outgoing payout network and provider costs so they do not reduce the accepted net amount. There is no additional PLAYORA withdrawal fee, wallet balance or site top-up. If a provider minimum would prevent this exact payout, we resolve it before accepting the offer, instead of withholding a small balance indefinitely.

Confirm the destination and any required memo through the authenticated transaction flow. Do not send a seed phrase, private key or wallet login. Address changes require verification before sending. We cannot reverse a confirmed transfer to a wrong destination you expressly confirmed, but we investigate available recovery options. PLAYORA remains responsible for an address or amount error made by its team. Provider checks and lawful restrictions may delay a transfer; we communicate the reason we can share and the next review time.

6. Withdrawing a sale

You can withdraw an unaccepted submission or decline an offer without a commission. After accepting a consignment offer, request withdrawal through your submission conversation. If the account is not reserved, sold or under a specific dispute hold, we unpublish it and arrange secure return of control, aiming to complete this within 48 hours. We charge no routine listing-removal fee.

If a buyer reservation or paid order exists, we explain its status and resolve it before returning control. Do not recover the account yourself while another person may have paid for it. A failed reservation must be reconciled before release. After a completed buy-first purchase, you cannot unilaterally take the account back; a reversal needs written agreement and coordinated return of both account and payment.

If a sale is cancelled before completion and no seller breach is established, no successful-sale commission is earned on that cancelled sale. For consignment, there are no sale proceeds to pay until a valid sale completes. A new sale or changed offer requires clear acceptance, not a hidden carry-over charge.

7. Buyer delivery and support

Read the listing’s game, region/server, attributes, included access, restrictions, transfer method and delivery range before paying. After verified payment we coordinate private handover. Perform agreed security changes, report missing access, and acknowledge delivery only after checking it.

Contact support about account purchase issues. We review the accepted listing, delivery records and evidence, then explain any remedy due under your order terms and applicable law. Not every post-delivery issue qualifies for a refund; eligibility and amount depend on review. Agreed-delivery refund protection and previously accepted agreements remain.

Ordinary play, contacting support and following agreed security instructions do not cancel protection. An allegation of cheating, unauthorized sharing or another buyer action must be connected by evidence to the particular problem; we do not presume fault because an issue appeared later. Completing the order, the seven-day inspection period, or a seller payout does not by itself prevent a review under the accepted terms. If the order's report button is unavailable, contact support@playoragames.com.

Publisher rules may prohibit account transfers. PLAYORA is not a publisher and cannot guarantee permanent access or immunity from enforcement. This disclosure does not override remedies due under the accepted order terms or applicable law. A replacement account or restoration may be offered, but cannot be forced instead of an eligible refund.

8. Disputes involving sellers

We review seller, buyer and PLAYORA evidence separately, preserve private conversations, and give the seller a chance to respond to an allegation. A buyer refund is not delayed until PLAYORA recovers money from a seller.

If a cancellation is caused by the buyer or PLAYORA and the seller fulfilled the accepted agreement, we do not automatically penalize the seller or recover an already-earned payout. If evidence establishes seller fraud, reclamation, false material information or another seller breach causing the loss, we may seek return of the attributable net payout or evidenced direct loss through a written settlement or lawful recovery process. We do not impose an automatic penalty, charge the buyer's 5% fee to the seller, collect twice for the same loss, or seize unrelated proceeds without a lawful basis. Any offset must be lawful, explained and supported by the accepted agreement or subsequent consent.

Request a second review through the submission conversation or support email. Our complaint process applies to both parties. Mandatory legal rights take priority over conflicting wording.

sections.text:
PLAYORA serves customers worldwide. Support, boosting, account services and shop fulfillment operate 24 hours a day, seven days a week, subject to the specific order's delivery conditions. You can ask a general question without creating an account.

1. Contact options

- Email: support@playoragames.com (mailto:support@playoragames.com).
- WhatsApp: message PLAYORA (https://wa.me/447415078674).
- Instagram: playora_service (https://www.instagram.com/playora_service/).
- Discord: PLAYORA's profile (https://discord.com/users/1553760636821962832). Discord may require sign-in, a friend request or suitable privacy settings before a message can be sent.

For an existing order, sign in and use its Messages or Help conversation. This keeps the order reference, evidence and progress together. Private order details and changes to access, refunds or payout destinations require appropriate account verification. Public contact remains available when you cannot sign in.

2. What to send

Tell us the game, service, order or submission reference if you have one, what you need, and any relevant time or error message. For access loss, an unexpected payment or a suspected security problem, say so at the start of the message. Remove unrelated personal details from screenshots.

Never send PLAYORA sign-in codes, authenticator or recovery codes, unrelated email passwords, wallet private keys or seed phrases. Use the protected access screen for game credentials. Staff will not ask you to pay a private social-media contact to unlock a refund or seller payout.

3. Response and escalation

We respond around the clock. A reply does not always mean a payment, investigation or order can finish immediately. We aim to provide substantive refund and complaint assessments within 72 hours of necessary evidence, updates at least every 48 hours on pending cases, and an appeal outcome within seven calendar days. Provider and blockchain confirmations may take additional time. Shorter applicable legal deadlines take priority.

For a privacy request, say which data or account you mean; we aim to respond within one calendar month, subject to any shorter applicable deadline. If you disagree with a decision, request a second review in the same conversation or by email.

Game pages contain their available service details, FAQs, news and guides. The accepted order remains the reference for your individual promises; general help cannot silently reduce them.
sections.title: Contact PLAYORA

sections.text:
1. How an order is agreed

PLAYORA offers services worldwide and operates support and fulfillment 24/7. Product availability still depends on the game, platform, region/server, stock, staff availability and supported payment route. Availability around the clock does not mean instant fulfillment.

Fixed packages have an administrator-defined scope, price and conditions. You choose whether to buy that package; required recipient or access details do not make it a custom quote. A custom-boost form collects your requested result and provides an estimate. Staff issue the final offer, and you accept its exact scope and price before payment. A requested option that has not been accepted is not a promise.

The accepted order records the game, region/server, current and target state, play mode, any hero/role restrictions, win-rate conditions, delivery range, whether timing is estimated or guaranteed, start conditions and completion evidence. Later catalog edits do not replace that agreement.

2. Delivery clocks and progress

The delivery clock starts when payment is verified and all agreed prerequisites are ready: correct account/recipient information, required secure access and, for playing together, the agreed available session. A reserved later appointment starts at that appointment. We identify a missing prerequisite and tell you how to resolve it; an unexplained internal queue does not silently move a guaranteed deadline.

Unless expressly stated otherwise in the accepted offer, a delivery range is an estimate in elapsed hours from that start event. A guaranteed upper bound is stated explicitly. Any proposed guaranteed-deadline change needs your agreement. We do not replace it with an estimated date after payment.

We record progress and delivery evidence in your order and aim to provide an update at least every 24 hours while active, and whenever a significant problem affects the plan. A timestamp shows when information was last updated. You can contact support at any time.

We explain pauses caused by missing access, your requested schedule, maintenance, a security concern or an investigation. Any effect on guaranteed timing must follow the accepted order or be agreed with you. A pause is not completion. If we cannot meet an agreed condition, the full-refund policy applies; further work or an extension is your choice.

3. Playing on your account

Only authorized staff and the assigned booster may use necessary game access for the accepted task. Share it through the protected access screen, never public uploads or ordinary chat. We do not need your PLAYORA codes, unrelated personal email password, payment login, wallet private key or seed phrase.

Our team must not use cheats or bots, make unauthorized purchases, sell or remove assets, change recovery ownership, or access unrelated communications. Necessary in-game actions must follow the agreed order. Coordinate your own login with the team to avoid conflicting sessions. Change temporary game access after completion or when support recommends it. Report unexpected access immediately.

4. Playing together

You play your own account and join the agreed session, region/server and mode. No game password is needed for ordinary party play. Confirm compatible access and availability before a timed appointment. If either side misses a session, we record the issue and agree rescheduling or the appropriate refund; no hidden no-show charge applies.

5. Win rate and match evidence

There is no universal minimum win rate. The final package or custom quote must state whether a WR condition is guaranteed and exactly what it measures. A preference alone is not a purchased guarantee. The current standard fixed rank packages do not include a WR target unless their accepted description expressly says so.

The default measurement for a separately accepted order-match WR guarantee is the number of won matches divided by the number of completed counted matches, multiplied by 100. The quote identifies the account, queue/mode, start/end points, and counted matches. Overall historical account WR and a particular hero's lifetime WR are different metrics and are not substituted for order-match WR. If the desired metric is historical WR, staff must expressly quote that metric and its starting data.

| Accepted preference | Meaning when expressly guaranteed |
| --- | --- |
| No preference | No numerical WR condition; the other agreed conditions still apply |
| Between X and Y | At least X% and at most Y%, inclusive |
| Below X | Strictly below X% |
| Above Y | Strictly above Y% |
| Exactly 100% | Every counted match must be a win |

We assess the actual fraction without rounding it into compliance. For example, 7 wins from 10 counted matches is exactly 70%, which meets a 70–80% range but not a strictly-above-70% requirement. A sample of zero matches has no WR and cannot satisfy a WR promise. Minimum match counts and any completion condition must be agreed beforehand.

A completed match played by our team within the agreed scope counts whether won or lost, including a completed match affected by disconnection. A publisher-recorded remake or void result without a completed outcome is excluded and identified. Customer-only matches outside an agreed team session are excluded from an order-match measure and logged separately. We do not selectively remove losses after the fact. A different rule must be explicit before acceptance and must not misrepresent the result.

We do not intentionally lose, manipulate matchmaking or continue extra games without agreement to fit an upper WR bound. If a range or below-threshold request would require that, staff must explain the problem and revise or decline it before acceptance. Once a condition is accepted, it cannot simply be ignored; failure engages the agreed refund protection.

6. Heroes, roles and game changes

The accepted quote identifies any mandatory hero or role and permissible alternatives. If an agreed hero is banned, unavailable or unsuitable after a patch, we follow the pre-agreed fallback or ask you before changing the restriction. A form's linked hero/role and region/server choices help selection; they do not authorize staff to replace the final agreement.

Record relevant starting rank, stars, season and game version. If a season reset, patch or publisher action prevents the promised result, we explain the situation. We do not silently substitute the new season's rank or treat a previous estimate as permission to miss a guaranteed condition. A mutually accepted revision or the refund policy resolves the affected order.

7. Completion, shop and account handover

Completion evidence must relate to the actual order and agreed result. Review it and report missing conditions. Marking an order complete does not remove an eligible refund or separate account-damage claim.

After verified payment and complete, valid details or required access, shop products use the delivery method stated in the accepted offer: instant top-up using player details, instant code delivery, account sign-in delivery in 24–72 hours, or manual fulfillment within the stated time. Their offer states the product, quantity, compatible region/server, recipient and delivery method. No substitution or extra charge is made without agreement. Incorrect, missing or unusable delivery and missed agreed conditions are covered by the full-refund policy; wrong recipient information supplied solely by the customer is investigated on its evidence.

Account listings identify included login/recovery access, transfer restrictions and a delivery range. Staff arrange private handover and security steps. A delivery acknowledgement should be given only after checking the promised access. The standard seven-day account inspection period is separate from the full-refund protection, which does not disappear when that period ends.

8. Information shared with staff

Assigned staff receive the order selections, necessary progress and minimum access required to perform their task. Buyer and seller private conversations remain separate. Staff access to protected credentials follows the approved secure workflow. Public listing or review permission is not consent to publish private proofs or use them in advertising.

Game publishers may prohibit boosting or account sharing and may take action against accounts. We are independent of them and do not promise immunity. This does not cancel PLAYORA's agreed full-refund or service-caused damage commitments. Open the game's service page for relevant FAQs and contact support@playoragames.com for order-specific help.

1. What the site stores

PLAYORA uses first-party cookies and browser storage to keep sign-in secure, return you to the requested page and preserve permitted non-secret selections during a short sign-in flow. Customer, admin and booster portals have separate sign-in contexts. These functions do not allow staff to inspect unrelated browsing activity.

| Item | Purpose | Duration |
| --- | --- | --- |
| __Host-bp-customer-session, __Host-bp-admin-session, __Host-bp-booster-session | Sign in to the corresponding portal | Cookie lifetime up to seven days; server-side inactivity expiry is 30 minutes and sessions may be revoked earlier |
| Corresponding __Host-bp-…-browser cookies | Bind a session or sign-in/security attempt to its browser | Up to 30 days from creation |
| playora.google-return.customer, .admin, .booster in session storage | Return to the intended page after Google sign-in | Consumed on return; ignored after ten minutes; remaining storage follows browser-session cleanup |
| playora.configuration in session storage | Restore allowed non-secret estimate selections after sign-in | Ignored after 15 minutes; removed by flow or browser-session cleanup, not a timed background deletion |

Permitted saved configuration excludes credentials, free-text answers and uploads. A stale storage entry is not an active order, payment or permission to process a secret.

The website follows the operating system's reduced-motion setting automatically. The historical boosterplus.motion preference is no longer used by the current motion controller. An old browser may still retain that unused local entry until site storage is cleared; it is not a currently required tracking or preference function.

2. Third-party services

Choosing Google sign-in, opening NOWPayments checkout, or following Discord, Instagram or WhatsApp links can involve those providers' storage and policies. We do not describe their cookies as PLAYORA's first-party session cookies. The private staff webmail application is a separate interface with its own authenticated session.

The reviewed customer application has no identified advertising or behavioral-analytics integration. If we introduce optional tracking that requires permission, it will not be activated merely because you accepted general service terms. We will explain it and provide the required choice.

3. Your controls

Your browser can block or delete site cookies and storage. Doing so may sign you out, prevent browser-binding checks or remove saved selections. Google or hosted checkout may not work if required storage is blocked. You can still email support@playoragames.com for help.

Sign out when using a shared device and use the portal's security controls to review or revoke sessions. Clearing one browser does not necessarily revoke a session on another device. For privacy questions, use the contact and rights process in the Privacy notice.

1. Open a case

Contact the order or submission Help conversation, or email support@playoragames.com. Tell us the reference, issue, relevant dates and outcome you seek. You can contact support if you cannot sign in or an in-app reporting window has closed. Support is available 24/7; we do not charge a complaint-handling fee.

Buyers and sellers use separate private conversations. We share only the information needed to understand and answer the allegation, with sensitive material protected. Never post credentials, codes or private financial information as public evidence.

2. How we review

We compare the accepted agreement with payment, delivery, access, progress, communication and relevant publisher evidence. We ask for information proportionate to the issue and retrieve records only PLAYORA holds ourselves. A problem appearing after completion is not automatically the customer's fault.

We aim to give a substantive assessment within 72 hours of receiving the necessary evidence. We explain any hold, what is outstanding and the next step, and provide updates at least every 48 hours while action is pending. A complicated case does not give us permission to ignore a shorter applicable legal deadline.

Our decision identifies the agreed condition, relevant evidence, reasoning and proposed remedy. A protected full refund includes the account buyer commission. Service-caused damage compensation is assessed separately; an undisputed refund is not withheld until compensation is settled. A buyer refund does not depend on first recovering funds from a seller.

3. Ask for another review

If you disagree, reply to the case or email support with the decision you challenge and anything missed or misunderstood. An additional authorized reviewer examines the decision where available. If staffing prevents a different reviewer, we explain that and still reconsider the evidence; we do not pretend an independent reviewer exists.

We aim to complete this review within seven calendar days, with reasons and an updated timeframe for any delay. The current in-app appeal limits are 30 days per appeal and up to three appeals. The interface also normally allows disputes for 365 days after boost/shop completion; account listings state their own inspection/reporting period. These interface limits do not extinguish the accepted protections, remove a mandatory right or prevent contacting support about new evidence.

For moderation, privacy or seller-offer issues without an order appeal control, the support email provides the same route to request review. Privacy requests follow their applicable deadlines, including our one-calendar-month response target.

4. Fair treatment and outside remedies

We do not retaliate for a genuine complaint, a negative review or the use of lawful dispute channels. Deliberately fabricated evidence, threats or account fraud may be investigated, but we preserve legitimate transaction obligations and mandatory rights. Security restrictions are not automatic forfeiture of paid orders or seller proceeds.

Nothing in this policy requires compulsory arbitration, waives a right that cannot lawfully be waived, or prevents contacting a competent consumer authority, data-protection authority, payment provider or court. No undisclosed country is designated as the only place you may seek a remedy. Inform us of a separate recovery already received so the same loss is not paid twice.
