PLAYORA Terms of Service

1. PLAYORA, worldwide service and 24/7 support

The PLAYORA team provides game boosting, game-account buying and selling, in-game shop services and game information at playoragames.com for customers worldwide. Availability depends on the game, server/region, offering, stock and lawful payment-provider coverage. A global service does not mean every product or payment route is available in every country.

We operate online 24 hours a day, seven days a week. Our support team responds around the clock, and our boosting, shop, account and other offered service teams process orders 24/7. Contact us in your order or account support conversation, or at support@playoragames.com.

24/7 operation means round-the-clock service and support, not that every order finishes immediately. Each order has its own delivery conditions, and payment confirmations, game maintenance or an ongoing investigation can take time. We keep you informed about interruptions that affect your order.

For help with a particular game, open its game page, choose the relevant service and read the offer details, available FAQs and guides. Your order page contains your agreed conditions, progress, messages and payment information. Ask support whenever you need clarification before buying.

2. Eligibility and account security

You must be at least 18 and old enough to enter a binding agreement under the laws that apply to you. You must have authority to use or transfer any game account you submit. Do not submit stolen accounts, fraudulent payments, misleading ownership evidence or unlawful material.

PLAYORA sign-in uses Google or email verification, without a PLAYORA password. Keep your Google/email account and authenticator secure. Never share PLAYORA sign-in codes, authenticator codes, recovery codes, wallet private keys or seed phrases with anyone, including staff. Tell support if you suspect unauthorized access.

Customer, administrator and booster portals use independent accounts with separate profiles, sessions, permissions and security settings. The same email may be used in each without merging these identities. Staff must complete their required second factor. We may restrict access to investigate credible abuse or security concerns, while preserving legitimate order obligations and applicable consumer rights.

3. Offers, estimates and accepted orders

Read the selected game, region/server, product, quantity, price, delivery conditions and requirements before ordering. Limited-stock, discounted and timed offers apply only while their stated conditions are met. Browsing a listing does not reserve it.

A custom-boost form gives an estimate. Staff review your request and issue the final quote. You review and accept the quote before payment. Fixed packages have specified prices and can go directly to checkout without a separate custom-quote approval.

The accepted order records what we agreed to deliver. We do not replace it with a later catalog description, change its price without agreement or silently remove a selected requirement. Fulfillment requires verified payment and the necessary agreed access or delivery information.

4. Boosting: every promise belongs to the package or order

Rank, win rate, hero, role, queue, play mode, scheduling, completion criteria and other boosting requirements are defined per package or accepted custom order. There is no website-wide win-rate target, rank promise or universal completion time.

Where win rate is included, the offer must explain which matches count, the measurement period and any agreed exclusions. If a requested condition is not included in the final quote, ask us to clarify it before acceptance. The accepted conditions are the ones we must fulfill.

An offering may involve playing on your account or playing together with you. Use the mode and secure access process specified in the order. Never put game credentials in ordinary messages or public screenshots. Do not share unrelated personal email access or financial credentials.

Every order is handled with the aim of delivering exactly what we agreed and protecting your account throughout the service. If we fall short or cause verified harm, we take responsibility through our refund and compensation commitments.

If we fail to fulfill an agreed deliverable or condition of your order, you are entitled to a 100% refund of that order's purchase amount. This includes a promised rank, win rate, hero/role restriction, quantity or guaranteed deadline that we do not meet. Partial work does not reduce this full-refund promise. An explicitly labelled estimate is not a guaranteed deadline; any change to an actual guarantee requires your agreement.

If required customer access or availability is missing, we explain the problem and agree how to proceed. We cannot silently treat a paused order as completed. A repair, repeat service, extension or replacement is optional for you when a full refund is due; we will not force you to accept it instead.

Account damage caused by our service

If PLAYORA or a booster or staff member acting on our behalf damages your account while providing a service, we take responsibility and provide fair monetary compensation for the verified harm. This is separate from any full order refund you are entitled to. Examples include damage to rank or win-rate statistics caused by our handling of the order, unauthorized spending or removal of in-game assets, loss of account access, or a restriction caused by our actions.

For rank or win-rate concerns, we review the account's starting position, relevant match history, the agreed match scope and conditions, and the effect of matches played by our team. A lower win rate can be reviewed even if no separate WR guarantee was purchased. Competitive play can include losses: a single loss or temporary fluctuation is not automatically compensable damage, and this clause does not promise that every match will be won. We explain how the evidence distinguishes ordinary play from harm caused by our service; we do not dismiss a claim simply because the order's final rank was reached.

The compensation amount is assessed case by case using the nature and extent of the damage, reasonable supported recovery or replacement costs, and any lasting loss. We explain our assessment and proposed monetary amount in writing; there is no universal payment per lost match or WR percentage point. We may offer restoration at our expense where feasible and with your consent, but we do not promise that a publisher can reverse statistics, restore items or remove a restriction. We will not force you to accept more gameplay, store credit or a replacement service instead of compensation for verified harm.

Report the issue through your order's support conversation or support@playoragames.com. We review evidence from both you and our team, without requiring you to obtain records only we hold. The review, updates and appeal process below also applies to damage claims. Before a compensation transfer, we confirm its amount, supported crypto asset/network and verified destination; PLAYORA covers the outgoing fee so the agreed compensation is not reduced. We account separately for the order refund and account damage, avoid paying twice for the same loss, and do not cap compensation automatically at the order price or make an undisputed refund depend on settling the damage claim. Your rights under applicable law remain unaffected.

5. Shop orders

PLAYORA supports shop orders 24/7. After verified payment and complete, valid details or required access, delivery follows the method stated in the offer: instant top-up using player details, instant code delivery, account sign-in delivery in 24–72 hours, or manual fulfillment within the stated time. Check the product, platform, region/server, quantity, recipient and delivery method before paying. A product page explains the information needed and the agreed delivery conditions.

If we fail to supply the agreed item, quantity or guaranteed delivery condition, the full-refund promise applies to the affected order. Report incorrect, missing, unusable or materially misdescribed delivery through its support conversation. Keep relevant delivery evidence and do not send another payment unless a new authenticated checkout clearly requires it.

When an issue is caused solely by incorrect recipient information you supplied and we delivered exactly as agreed, we investigate recovery options rather than automatically treating it as our fulfillment failure. Mandatory rights still apply, and no new recovery charge is imposed without your agreement.

6. Buying accounts and account protection

Read the account's game, region/server, attributes, access included, restrictions and handover steps before purchase. We verify payment before secure delivery. Complete the stated security steps and report any missing access or discrepancy promptly.

Contact order support if there is a problem with your account purchase. PLAYORA reviews the accepted listing, delivery records and relevant evidence, explains its findings and any remedy due under your order terms and applicable law. Refund eligibility and amount depend on that review; there is no blanket refund guarantee for every issue arising after delivery. Failure to deliver an expressly agreed condition remains covered by our agreed-order refund protection. Previously accepted agreements retain their protections.

We review the order description, access history, dates, messages and available publisher notices. We do not presume that the buyer caused an issue merely because it appeared after delivery. Ordinary play and following our agreed password/security-change instructions do not, by themselves, cancel protection. Publisher rules do not replace the remedies due under your accepted order terms or applicable law.

Buyer-caused harm can include cheating/botting, abuse, sharing access with an unauthorized person, reselling/transferring the account or deliberate destruction, when the evidence connects that action to the reported problem. It is not enough to assert an unrelated rule violation. Fraudulent claims are not covered.

Marking an order delivered or completed does not by itself prevent a review under your accepted terms. Report problems promptly so evidence can be preserved; these terms impose no hidden short reporting cutoff. We explain an adverse decision and offer a review by another authorized reviewer where available. You keep any rights to an independent complaint or remedy under applicable law.

7. Selling an account to or through PLAYORA

Customers may submit accounts for staff review. Submission does not guarantee approval, purchase or resale. Disclose relevant restrictions and provide accurate control/ownership evidence. Public screenshots must not expose credentials or unrelated personal information.

Every seller offer identifies one of two arrangements:

- PLAYORA buys first: the accepted offer states the purchase amount, required verified transfer and payout due event/deadline before resale. Resale performance does not create a new condition for paying an already-due purchase obligation.
- Resale/consignment: the accepted offer states seller proceeds or commission, the buyer-payment and handover conditions, any clearly stated dispute hold and when payment becomes due.

For new account agreements, the buyer pays a commission of 5% of the account base price in addition to that price. The seller pays a commission of 10% of the agreed base price, deducted from proceeds. For a $100 base price, the buyer pays $105 and the seller receives $90. Each fee is independently rounded to the nearest USD cent, with exact half cents rounded upward. These account commissions do not apply to boosting or shop purchases. The base, fee and payable/net total must be visible before agreement. No separate submission, listing or payout-unlock fee is charged.

A protected full account refund includes the buyer's 5% commission. Seller obligations are assessed separately, not automatically increased by that buyer fee. PLAYORA bears outgoing payout costs so the accepted seller net is not reduced. Required taxes, if applicable, must be accounted for within confirmed amounts and disclosed before acceptance, never added as a surprise afterward.

For consignment, the ordinary buyer inspection period is seven calendar days after acknowledged delivery. Once verified funds, completed delivery/order and any relevant dispute or refund review permit payout, we aim to initiate it within 48 hours with a verified destination. That period is not an expiry of buyer protection. A seller hold must be explained, regularly reviewed and limited to the matter concerned. A missing buyer acknowledgement is investigated, not fabricated.

For buy-first offers, we aim to initiate the accepted net payment within 48 hours after verified account control and a verified destination. Resale publication follows confirmed seller payment. A different eventual resale price does not change the already-agreed seller payout; the new buyer's 5% fee is calculated on the resale base. The 15% combined-commission illustration assumes the same buyer and seller base.

An offer shows the exact net crypto amount, rate/source and quote timestamp before acceptance. The initial route is USDT on BNB Smart Chain (BEP-20). We do not assume USDT always equals one USD or silently reprice an accepted crypto obligation. An unaccepted offer normally expires after seven calendar days; a shorter expiry is clearly shown. No policy edit applies new fees retroactively to an accepted agreement.

An unaccepted submission can be withdrawn without commission. An unsold, unreserved consignment can be withdrawn through support with secure return of control, targeted within 48 hours. Existing reservations, paid sales and specific disputes must be resolved first. Do not recover the account yourself during that process. A completed buy-first purchase cannot be unilaterally reversed. A failed or cancelled sale does not earn a successful-sale commission merely because it was listed.

A PLAYORA-funded discount does not reduce the seller's accepted net proceeds; an agreed change in the base price requires fresh acceptance. If the seller fulfilled the agreement, a buyer- or PLAYORA-caused cancellation is not automatic grounds for a penalty or recovery of an earned payout. Proven seller fraud, reclamation or material breach can create an evidenced repayment or damages claim, with a right to respond and request review. We do not impose arbitrary penalties, collect twice, or silently seize unrelated proceeds. A lawful offset needs an explained basis in the accepted agreement or later consent.

The offer also specifies payout asset/network, fees, recipient verification, responsibility for account problems, withdrawal conditions and the treatment of buyer refunds. No commission, price, waiting period or payout deduction is invented after you accept. Changes require fresh acceptance. Before acceptance you may use the available withdrawal process; afterward the agreement and applicable rights govern withdrawal.

Buyer refunds and seller obligations are handled separately. A buyer's eligible full refund is not conditional on our first recovering money from a seller. Buyer and seller conversations remain separate. PLAYORA offers neither a user wallet nor an escrow service under these terms.

8. Direct cryptocurrency payments

Only the assets and networks shown in checkout are supported. Follow the invoice's exact amount, destination, network, validity and memo instructions. Review displayed conversion and fees before authorizing a transfer. Payments are direct purchases; you cannot top up a PLAYORA wallet.

A transfer screenshot or transaction hash is not sufficient proof of payment. We verify provider evidence and reconcile underpayments, overpayments, late payments, duplicate payments and expired reservations. Extra funds do not become store credit, and a late transfer does not take stock already sold to someone else.

Wrong-network or wrong-address transfers may be unrecoverable. Contact authenticated support to investigate; never disclose wallet recovery material. Provider outages, confirmation times and compliance reviews can delay a result. NOWPayments may request verification or restrict a transaction under its own policies; we cannot promise that it will never do so.

9. Refund amount, cancellation and processing

For a refund covered by our full-refund promise, we return 100% of the purchase payment allocated to the affected order, including charges collected by PLAYORA for that order. We make no deduction for work already performed, administration, our original processing costs or the cost of sending the refund. PLAYORA bears the outgoing refund fee so it does not reduce that amount.

Our default is to return the original crypto asset and the original number of units allocated to the order. This avoids silently choosing a later exchange rate. A different supported asset/network or valuation method requires your express agreement, with its exact amount disclosed beforehand. Separately charged wallet/exchange costs paid directly to a third party, unrelated later in-game purchases and changes in market value are not part of the order purchase amount; this does not restrict any further remedy required by law.

Duplicate or excess payments are accounted for separately and are not forfeited or turned into a site balance. A previous partial refund counts toward the total refund for that same order, so you are not paid the same amount twice.

After payment is confirmed, orders cannot be cancelled simply because you change your mind. If payment, delivery or the agreed service has a problem, contact order support. This rule does not reduce a full refund owed for an unfulfilled agreement, failed or incorrect delivery, an account remedy due under the accepted terms, or any cancellation, withdrawal or refund right required by law. Existing accepted orders retain their original terms.

Request a refund from the order's Help/support conversation or email support with the order reference. We may need relevant evidence and a verified recipient address, asset/network and memo. An exchange's sending address is not automatically a safe refund destination. Do not return credentials or items to an unverified contact; support will coordinate any necessary safe handback without making you recover an inaccessible account yourself.

We aim to give a substantive assessment within 72 hours of receiving the necessary evidence and to initiate an approved refund within 48 hours of confirming a usable destination. These are service targets, not permission to miss a shorter legal deadline. If provider checks or a complex investigation prevent completion, we explain what is outstanding and provide updates at least every 48 hours while action remains pending. Blockchain/provider confirmation may take additional time. We report completion only when transfer evidence is verified.

Where applicable law provides withdrawal or additional refund rights, those rights remain available. A generic terms acceptance does not waive a withdrawal right or record any separately required request for early performance.

10. Game rules, content and safe use

PLAYORA is independent of game publishers unless expressly stated otherwise. Publishers may prohibit boosting, sharing or transferring accounts and can restrict accounts. Read the game-specific information before buying. We do not claim publisher endorsement or immunity from enforcement. These risks do not erase the full-refund protections expressly promised above.

Use support, reviews and uploads responsibly. Do not harass people, fabricate evidence or publish private information. We use submitted material to operate and support the transaction; private chats and proof are not advertising permission. We seek separate permission for marketing use of private customer material.

Game FAQs and service help explain selection, delivery, access, payment and issue reporting. Staff-managed news, patch notes and guides may become outdated when games change; an article is not an additional order guarantee. If help text conflicts with an accepted order or the full-refund promise, contact support; a generic help article cannot silently reduce an agreed protection.

11. Complaints and changes

Our support is available 24/7. If you disagree with a decision, reply in the case or email support and request a second review. We explain the evidence and reasons, allow relevant additional evidence and aim to finish the review within seven calendar days; delays receive a reason and updated timeframe. We do not impose a short appeal deadline that removes mandatory rights.

Nothing here excludes liability or rights that applicable law does not allow us to exclude. We do not require compulsory arbitration or claim that only a court in an undisclosed location can hear your complaint.

Changes are published as dated versions. Existing order agreements remain available and are not silently rewritten. The Privacy Notice explains how we use personal information. This version applies from its recorded publication date to new agreements. Earlier accepted orders and seller offers keep their agreed prices.

12. Reviews, privacy and related policies

Reviews are optional and must describe real experience. Positive and negative feedback follow the same moderation rules. We do not condition refunds, payouts or support on a positive review or removal of criticism. We may remove exposed secrets, threats, unlawful material, impersonation or spam, with reasons and a review route. Formatting or redaction must not change a review's meaning. Public feedback permission does not authorize advertising use of private conversations or proof.

The Privacy and Cookies notices explain the information and storage used for these services. Reading a notice or accepting these terms is not consent to unrelated optional marketing. You may contact support for privacy requests while automated deletion is disabled.

The Account Buying and Selling, Refunds, Delivery and Boosting, Shop, Reviews and Content, and Complaints policies provide service-specific detail. Read the versions presented with your order or offer. A later version does not rewrite an accepted contract. Mandatory law takes precedence; the express full-refund and service-caused damage protections cannot be silently reduced by a listing, help article, inspection timer or general disclaimer. If wording conflicts, support must clarify it before purchase rather than rely on a hidden exception afterward.

PLAYORA Privacy Notice

1. Who handles your information

The PLAYORA team operates PLAYORA's worldwide game services. Contact support@playoragames.com or your private support conversation for questions or privacy requests. Support is available 24/7; a substantive investigation may take longer than an initial reply.

This notice covers customers, account sellers and people using PLAYORA's public site and account portals. Staff and booster accounts are independent identities, with separate profiles, sessions, permissions and security settings, even when the same email is used. Information is accessed across those boundaries only as needed for authorized work, not because the emails match.

2. Information we use

| Information | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| Email, display name, account identifier and accepted agreement versions | Sign-in, account administration, communication and contracts |
| Google identity/verified email when selected, email challenges, sessions, browser binding, authenticator material and security events | Authentication, recovery and protection against misuse |
| Game, region/server, rank, hero/role and WR preferences, quotes, orders, delivery details and progress | Estimate, agree and perform the selected service |
| Account-sale attributes, images, ownership evidence, offers and transfer records | Assess submissions, publish permitted listings and perform buyer/seller agreements |
| Necessary private game access | Perform only the authorized task or secure handover |
| Invoice references, asset/network, amounts, transaction evidence and refund/payout destinations | Verify payment, calculate disclosed fees and administer financial obligations |
| Support chat/email, attachments and case notes | Answer questions, investigate claims and provide remedies |
| Favorites, optional alert choices and public review submissions | Provide requested convenience functions and publish permitted feedback |
| Relevant request, network, device/browser and operational/security records | Run the service, prevent abuse and investigate faults |

Information comes from you, your use of PLAYORA, your chosen sign-in/payment providers, and authorized staff performing the service. A buyer may supply information about a transferred account and a seller's claim; we use it for that transaction, not as permission to expose their private conversations.

PLAYORA uses Google or email sign-in and has no customer password or stored-value wallet. Google sign-in requests identity and email claims, not access to your Gmail messages. Never submit unrelated email passwords, wallet private keys, seed phrases or unnecessary identity documents through ordinary order chat.

3. Purposes and choices

We process necessary account and transaction information to take steps you request and perform your agreements. Security, fraud prevention, service administration and claim defense rely on proportionate legitimate interests where recognized by applicable law. We use a legal-obligation basis only where an actual applicable requirement exists. Optional processing that requires consent has a separate choice; agreeing to general terms is not blanket marketing consent.

Required order information is necessary to provide that service. Optional alerts and reviews are separate, and Google sign-in is optional when email sign-in is available. Withdrawing optional consent does not undo earlier lawful processing or stop necessary transaction/security notices.

Rules calculate estimates and check permissions, availability and payment state. Staff review final custom quotes and contested refund/account decisions. Ask support for an explanation or human review of an incorrect result.

4. Who receives information

Authorized staff and assigned boosters receive only the information needed for their task. Private access is restricted and audited. Seller and buyer private messages are not automatically visible to one another. Permitted public listing details and reviews are different from private proof and credentials.

Infrastructure providers support hosting, DNS, network protection and the operation of self-hosted database, private storage and email services. Google authenticates people who select it. NOWPayments processes crypto transactions and its own verification and compliance checks. Your email provider receives messages addressed to you. Social platforms receive information you choose to send through their contact links. Public blockchains may independently expose addresses, amounts and transaction history.

Google and NOWPayments operate under their own privacy notices, available through their services. Provider reviews may require additional information; PLAYORA cannot promise anonymity or that a third party will never request identity verification.

We do not sell personal information or share it for targeted advertising. Private chat, proof and game access are not advertising permission. Separate permission is required for marketing use of private customer material. Proportionate disclosures may be necessary for an applicable legal obligation or a genuine claim; access must be limited to that purpose.

5. International processing

Customers, authorized personnel and service providers may be in different countries, so information may be processed outside your country. Worldwide service does not imply that all data remains in one place. Applicable transfer requirements and safeguards must be respected. Contact support for the recipients, locations and transfer arrangements relevant to your information; we do not claim an unverified adequacy decision or certification.

6. Storage and retention

We retain information only while it serves an identified transaction, security, claim or applicable legal purpose. The retention schedule distinguishes ordinary messages from essential financial and dispute evidence. Longer retention requires a recorded reason affecting the particular records, not an indefinite hold on everything.

Our approved retention review targets are: ordinary closed support material and routine security/audit records at 365 days; closed dispute evidence at 730 days after closure; and limited commercial/payment evidence at 730 days after settlement. Category-specific automatic cleanup is not yet enabled. These are review targets, not a claim that records are already erased at those ages or a universal legal minimum. We assess verified requests individually and explain specific accounting, tax or claim requirements and necessary holds.

Eligible profile information should be removed or anonymized within 30 days of a verified closure request, subject to specific lawful holds and any shorter legal deadline. Necessary credentials must be removed as soon as authorized access is no longer needed, with an approved review target of 30 days after completed handover/fulfillment absent a specific justified hold. Other temporary data follows its actual technical expiry and cleanup process. Public review attribution is assessed separately from retained financial evidence.

Automatic customer deletion is not enabled. You can still submit a rights request through support. A pending self-service feature does not remove your rights. We distinguish expired access, restricted retained evidence, anonymization and actual file deletion; one is not a promise that every copy has disappeared.

The deployment does not currently have a qualified off-host backup/recovery system. Before one is introduced, copy retention, expiry, restricted restoration and reapplication of deletion decisions must be documented. PLAYORA cannot erase independently maintained public blockchain records.

7. Cookies and security

PLAYORA uses first-party sign-in and browser-binding cookies and limited session storage for safe return navigation and non-secret form selections. The Cookies notice describes their purposes and lifetimes. The site follows your device's reduced-motion setting; there is no active site preference that needs a stored motion choice.

The reviewed application has no identified advertising or behavioral-analytics integration. If optional tracking is introduced, we explain it and obtain any required choice before activation. Selecting a third-party sign-in, payment or social link can involve that provider's own storage.

We use encrypted transport, role-based permissions, required staff second factors and protected game-access storage. These safeguards reduce risk; they do not guarantee that information cannot be lost or misused. Report suspected unauthorized access promptly without putting secrets in the report.

8. Your rights

You may request access, correction, deletion, restriction or portability and object to processing where applicable law provides those rights. You can object to processing based on legitimate interests and withdraw optional consent. We may need proportionate confirmation of account control, using secure channels, rather than unnecessary identity documents in chat.

We aim to respond within one calendar month and respect any shorter applicable deadline. If a permitted extension is necessary, we explain its reason and new deadline. We identify any records that cannot yet be erased and why, rather than describing partial deletion as total erasure. Exports contain authorized records; store them privately.

You may complain to a competent data-protection authority under the law that applies to you. Our complaint process does not remove that right. PLAYORA is intended for people aged 18 or older who can enter a binding agreement; contact us about suspected underage use. This is not a claim that document-based age verification is already implemented.

9. Changes

The effective version and date are recorded with this publication. Material changes receive the notice or choice required by applicable law. Old terms acceptance is not permission for unlimited new uses of information.
